name: gap-extension-builtin-plugins
about: extension.builtinPluginsEnabled 关掉内置插件 funasr（pilot/config/loadPilotConfig.ts:747-763）：发给模型的工具清单里不再有 mcp__funasr__*；同时给一个非布尔值的项（被过滤）。比较请求里的工具清单与 mcp_server_status。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
extension:
  builtinPluginsEnabled:
    funasr: false
    other: "yes"
